steps.title: First light in Leonida
steps.summary: The opening hours and Chapter 1. Start the two habits that protect the whole run here: meditate at every spot the moment you reach it, and keep a manual save before major story choices.
steps.ponr_note: The meditation watch starts here. Positive Mental Attitude may depend on Chapter 1 spots staying reachable - unconfirmed, but the safe habit costs nothing: meditate at each spot when you first reach it, never later.

steps.title: Chapters 2 and 3
steps.summary: The story spine through the middle chapters, with the named missions that carry their own trophies.

steps.title: Chapter 4 and the big scores
steps.summary: The last numbered chapter and the set-piece missions - the Cartel Heist above all. Come armed and funded.

steps.title: Strangers and strands
steps.summary: Every stranger strand, finished one at a time: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and Cal. Their finales carry six trophies and most of the Strangers & Freaks silver.

steps.title: Leonida at large
steps.summary: The open state: stunts, the shooting range, races, cards, WAiNK locations, exploration and the money milestones. Route this district by district alongside everything else.

steps.title: Heat, feats and the unexplained
steps.summary: Partner crime, set-piece robberies, combat feats - and the trophies nobody has decoded yet, handled with readings and safe habits rather than invented methods.

steps.title: The finale and the long road
steps.summary: The final mission, then the 100% checklist, then the platinum that awards itself. If the count stalls, the board's per-kind counts show exactly what is left.
